task: Create a simple one-page UI that introduces the tee-engine project for hackathon judges and developers.
project_summary: TEE Engine is a Python runtime that executes user-submitted AI agents inside a restricted sandbox, tracks LLM usage, and returns structured results for an agent challenge platform running on Phala Cloud TEE infrastructure.
project_highlights: Loads harness.py, agent.md, config.json, and optional RAG documents from a submission directory
Executes user code with RestrictedPython-based sandbox guards
Injects an OpenAI-compatible Near AI Cloud client into the user harness as llm
Tracks wall-clock time and per-call token usage
Returns a structured ExecutionResult with output, score, metadata, and errors
